name: Kawasaki S1 / S2 / S3 (KH250 / KH400)
engine: 249 to 400 cc air-cooled two-stroke triple, three carbs, oil injection
intro: The small Kawasaki two-stroke triples. Three carbs, oil injection and crank seals to check on every survivor.

add.title: Check the oil injection pump
add.instructions: Make sure the oil tank feeds the pump, bleed the lines, and check the pump cable so it opens with the throttle.
add.reason: A two-stroke with no oil supply seizes quickly.

B: A two-stroke with leaking crank seals runs lean and can seize. Get the seals checked before riding hard.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
